status: Reserved CLI behavior; no CLI executable or production SDK shipped by API-01

credential_input.node_recovery: worker-owned node credential binding; not accepted as agent token

commands.input: strict CommandRequest JSON; journal exact canonical bytes and operation ID before transport

json_output: Exactly the validated public response on stdout; structured errors on stderr; never claim success for pending/unknown/conflict
mutation_timeout: Print original operation ID and unknown/possible effect; query existing status, then replay only original bytes/ID if authority and persisted retry budget permit
operation_not_found: Not proof of no graph effect; preserve uncertainty, never generate a replacement key automatically
retry: Persist attempt count and suspend-aware elapsed budget across process restart; bounded jittered backoff from resolved profile; exhaustion requires manual reconciliation
cache: Private, bounded, read-only and scoped by session/generation/profile/context digests plus observation time; a cached value never authorizes a new operation
redaction: Do not log bearer values, token file contents, raw invalid JSON, unauthorized records, unfiltered graph errors or source paths
